## Introduction

This document outlines steps taken to produce the attenuated vegetation quality (AV) metric for Melbourne Water streams. The metric is an edited version of Chris Walsh's Attenuated Forest cover (AF) metric [@walsh2014], calculated with in-stream hyperparameterisation only (AF measures overland and in-stream attenuation jointly).

```{r}
#| label: prepare_av_site_data

library(terra)
library(sf)
library(DBI)

# Connect to mwstr database:
mwstr <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), 
                      "~/uomShare/wergStaff/ChrisW/mwstr_v13/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg")


subcs <- sf::st_read(mwstr, 
                       query = paste0("SELECT subcs.reach, subcs.site, subcs.nextds, subcs.nus, ",
                                      "subcs.agg_order, subc_env.d2ol_pp, subcs.geom, subcs.tot_length_m FROM subcs ",
                                      "JOIN subc_env ON subcs.site = subc_env.site ",
                                      "ORDER BY subcs.agg_order, subcs.nus, subcs.reach;"))


sf::st_crs(subcs) <- 7855 # Set CRS to EPSG:7855 (GDA2020 / MGA zone 55)
subcs_t <- terra::vect(subcs) # Convert to terra vector
sf::st_geometry(subcs) <- NULL # Remove geometry from subcs to save memory
subcs_ig <- apply(subcs[c("site","nextds")], 2, as.character) # Create graph dataframe from subcs
subcs_ig <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(subcs_ig) # Convert to igraph object
rm(subcs) # Remove subcs to save memory

subc_pps <- sf::st_read(mwstr, query = "SELECT * FROM subc_pps;") # Read in subc_pps table
subc_pps <- subc_pps[match(subcs_t$site, subc_pps$site),] # Reorder subc_pps to match subcs_t
subc_pps <- terra::vect(subc_pps) # Convert to terra vector

# Rasterize stream network tiffs:
r_site <- terra::rast(paste0(tiff_dir, "/r_site.tif"))
d2str <- terra::rast(paste0(tiff_dir, "/r_d2str.tif"))
d2ol <- terra::rast(paste0(tiff_dir, "/r_d2ol.tif"))

# Cropping vegq to match the extent of r_site:
vegq <- terra::rast(veg_tiff)
if(terra::crs(r_site) != terra::crs(vegq)) {
  vegq <- project(vegq, terra::crs(r_site))
}
vegq_cropped <- terra::crop(vegq, r_site)
vegq_cor <- resample(vegq_cropped, r_site, method = "bilinear")
veg_4 <- c(r_site, d2str, d2ol, vegq_cor)
names(veg_4)[1:3] <- c("site","d2str","d2ol")
prepared_vq_list <- list(subcs = subcs_t, subcs_ig = subcs_ig, 
       subc_pps = subc_pps, veg_4 = veg_4)
gc() 
rm(r_site, d2str, d2ol)



```

## Deriving attenuated vegetation quality for 132 streams in the network



```{r}
#| label: calculate_av

source("code/compile_prepared_vv.R")

aq_site <- function(sitecode_or_reach,
                    prepared_data,
                    W = 1000,
                    max_us = 16000) {
  
  list2env(prepared_data, environment())
  
  last_char <- substr(sitecode_or_reach,
                      nchar(sitecode_or_reach),
                      nchar(sitecode_or_reach))
  
  reachi <- ifelse(last_char %in% 0:9,
                   sitecode_or_reach,
                   substr(sitecode_or_reach,
                          1,
                          nchar(sitecode_or_reach) - 1))
  
  sitei <- subcs$site[subcs$reach == reachi]
  
  ppn_us <- ifelse(last_char %in% 0:9,
                   0,
                   (match(last_char, letters[1:10]) - 1) * 0.1)
  
  m_dus <- ppn_us * subcs$tot_length_m[subcs$site == sitei]
  
  d2oli <- subcs$d2ol_pp[subcs$site == sitei] + m_dus
  allusi <- subcs$site[igraph::subcomponent(subcs_ig, as.character(sitei), "in")]
  allusi_d2ol <- subcs$d2ol_pp[match(allusi, subcs$site)]
  
  # Restrict the analysis to upstream sites within max_us
  allusi_within_max_us <- allusi[allusi_d2ol < d2oli + max_us]
  cati <- subcs[subcs$site %in% allusi_within_max_us, ]
  rasti <- terra::crop(veg_4, cati, mask = TRUE)
  
  # Include only grid cells upstream of the site of interest
  terra::values(rasti$d2ol)[
    terra::values(rasti$d2ol) < d2oli
  ] <- NA
  
  # Retain only grid cells assigned to upstream sites
  rasti$site <- terra::ifel(
    terra::values(rasti$site) %in% allusi_within_max_us &
      !is.na(rasti$site),
    rasti$site,
    NA
  )
  
  rasti <- terra::mask(rasti, rasti$site)
  rasti <- terra::trim(rasti)
  
  # Correct minor inconsistencies between subcatchments and raster data
  allusi_d2ol <- subcs$d2ol_pp[match(allusi_within_max_us, subcs$site)]
  
  for (i in seq_along(allusi_within_max_us)) {
    rasti$d2ol <- terra::ifel(
      rasti$site == allusi_within_max_us[i] &
        rasti$d2ol < allusi_d2ol[i] - 20,
      NA,
      rasti$d2ol
    )
  }
  
  # Calculate distance from the site, separating stream and land distances
  d2ol_lw <- rasti$d2ol - d2oli
  rasti$d2ol <- d2ol_lw - rasti$d2str
  
  # Exclude cells below the site along the stream network
  rasti$d2ol <- terra::ifel(
    d2ol_lw < 0,
    NA,
    rasti$d2ol
  )
  
  rasti <- terra::mask(rasti, rasti$d2ol)
  
  # Apply exponential attenuation along W only (in-stream length)
  weight <- exp(log(0.5) * rasti$d2ol / W)
  
  # Calculate the weighted mean of the spatial variable
  aq <- terra::global(rasti$lyr1 * weight,
                      fun = "sum",
                      na.rm = TRUE)$sum /
        terra::global(weight * 25,
                      fun = "sum",
                      na.rm = TRUE)$sum
  
  gc()
  aq
}

# Site names for 132 streams in the network:
load("~/uomShare/wergStaff/RyanBurrows/Students/Nathan/Data/sites_nathan_bugs3.RData")

sitecodes <- sites_nathan_bugs3$sitecode_v12

if(is.null(sites_nathan_bugs3$aq_w1000)){
  sites_nathan_bugs3$aq_w1000 <- NA
}

time_record <- Sys.time()
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_nathan_bugs3)){
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  print(paste0("Calculating aq for site ", i, " of ", nrow(sites_nathan_bugs3)))
  sites_nathan_bugs3$aq_w1000[i] <- aq_site(sites_nathan_bugs3$sitecode_v12[i],
                                             prepared_data = prepared_vq_list,
                                             W = 1000,
                                             max_us = 8000)
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  print(paste0("Finished calculating aq for site ", i, " of ", nrow(sites_nathan_bugs3), 
               " in ", round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2), " minutes."))
  print(paste0("Estimated time remaining: ", round((difftime(end_time, time_record, units = "mins")/i) * (nrow(sites_nathan_bugs3) - i), 2), " minutes."))
}

saveRDS(sites_nathan_bugs3, file = "~/uomShare/wergStaff/RyanBurrows/Students/Nathan/Data/sites_nathan_bugs3_aq_w1000.rds")

```
